title: The strategic role of financial management
log: 2026-10-29T12:22:32Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No existing point covers the strategic role of financial management; related points like financing a new business or monitoring performance are narrower and pitched at Year 11 start-up and planning contexts.

draft.title: The strategic role of financial management
card: Financial management is planning and monitoring a business's money. It aims to give the business the funds it needs, use them well and meet its goals.
deciding ahead how much money the business needs, when it needs it and where it will come from, such as owner funds or a loan.
checking actual results against the plan, such as through budgets and financial reports, so problems are found early and fixed.
It is strategic because money decisions are tied to the business's goals. A business with no plan for its funds may not be able to pursue those goals.
draft.remember: Plan the money, check the results, and keep both linked to the business's goals.

a.q: Which action is an example of monitoring in financial management?
opts: Comparing last month's actual spending with the budget
Deciding to take out a loan to open a second store
Setting a target for how much cash is needed next year
Choosing to raise funds from the owners rather than a bank
a.why: Monitoring means checking actual results against the plan. Comparing spending with the budget does this. The other options are planning decisions made ahead of time, so the loan option is tempting but is not monitoring.
a.clue: Monitoring looks at what has already happened.

b.q: Tariq runs a bakery in Orange. He expects to buy a new oven in eight months and works out how much to save each month and where the rest will come from. Which part of financial management is this?
opts: Planning, because he is deciding funds ahead of need
Monitoring, because he is tracking the money he has saved
Monitoring, because he is checking the oven's cost
Planning, because the oven will increase his sales
b.why: Tariq is deciding ahead how much money he needs, when and from where, which is planning. Saving each month is part of the plan, not a check of results against it. Whether the oven raises sales is not what makes this planning.
b.clue: Has Tariq checked results yet, or is he setting out what to do?

a.best: Comparing last month's actual spending with the budget

b.best: Planning, because he is deciding funds ahead of need
